notes.title: An Update is brewin'!
notes.notes: We'll soon add some patches and updates to make sure you get the proper Elf experience. Hold on to you hats and bells and let's get ready for a lovely time at Santa's workshop!

notes.title: RELEASE the kraken!
notes.notes:
It is our pleasure to present to you, and welcome our newborn game at this late hour. Jingle! 🤩
Born at 12/12.2018 - 00:12 am (GTM+1), Jingle came to this world a little later than expect, but now it all seems so worth it. Weighing in at 2669 MB, the doctor told us it's in pretty good shape. Nevertheless it's a beauty to behold. ❤️

We really grateful for everyone's support, also with a special shout-out to everyone at Hamar Game Collective, and congratulations on being Jingle's new godparents.
We hope everyone's excited to join us and Jingle in it's first stages of life. 
Thanks!
